audience: Turkish businesses that keep customer cards, invoices, stock and orders in Evobulut

useCases.title: Review a customer's invoices and their payments
useCases.text: Find the customer card, list the invoices for a date range, then read the payments applied to one invoice.

useCases.title: Find stock items and their quantity per warehouse
useCases.text: Search stock items by name or code, then read the quantity of one item in each warehouse.

useCases.title: Review quotes and open orders
useCases.text: List quotes by customer and date range, and open one for its header, totals and lines. List the orders that are still open.

useCases.title: Add a company card for a new customer
useCases.text: Create a company card with the name, tax office and tax number. The server returns the new id. Nothing is deleted.

useCases.title: Assign a follow-up task to a colleague
useCases.text: Read the tasks of one Evobulut user, then create a task with a due date for that user. The start date is today.
